title: Berserker Warhammer Build
lede: A build from level 1 to 40. You level on Axe & Shield (the Berserker's default weapon), add the Warhammer in Gylden Ruins, and finish with both trees complete.

notice.title: Checked against your Traits screen. Not tested in-game.
notice.text: Both trees match your Warhammer and Axe screens node for node (41 and 52 nodes). Costs follow the in-game markers: "3" nodes cost 3, all others 1, and granted skills (✓) are free. Where branches split and rejoin you take one side, and the other turns red [me]. The plan spends 93 of the 94 Early Access points. Build choices and stat numbers are my recommendations, tagged as such.

stages.name: Leveling
stages.goal: Level quickly and safely with Axe & Shield. Carry the Warhammer so you can practice its charge timing on armored mobs.
weapons: Axe & Shield as your main weapon [ok]
skills: Brutal Crash staggers enemies and reduces the damage they deal [one]
Battle Cry heals you and staggers enemies, bosses included [one]
Shield Up plus Death Ward gives a 15 s window where you can't die [one]
On the hammer: Power Surge, then Tempered Blow (hold block, then release) [ok]
traits: Diamond Shores has 11 Coilstones = 22 points. All 22 go to Axe & Shield: Death Ward, Battle Cry upgrades, Shield Slam, Twin Pulse, Reel In, Brutal Crash [me]
Pulverize, Power Surge, Tempered and Devastating Blow are granted free on the Warhammer, so you can practice it with 0 points [ok]
gear: Royal Army Warhammer and Gatekeeper Harrod are early hammer drops [one]
You can respec stats for free at major towns or regional camps [one]
check: Put Axe & Shield and Warhammer on Q swap
Unlock Death Ward and Shield Slam
Get all 11 Diamond Shores Coilstones (22 points)

stages.name: Gearing
stages.goal: Upgrade your hammer and get the Meteor Hammer chain working.
weapons: Gatekeeper Harrod as your starter hammer [one]
skills: Meteor Hammer → Meteor Hammer II, so Tempered and Devastating Blow stack levels [ok]
Masterpiece takes Meteor Hammer to Lv. 3 [one]
traits: Gylden Ruins has 14 Coilstones = +28, for 50 total. The Warhammer gets 18 (Meteor Hammer → Galactic Impact → Lightning Collision) and Axe & Shield 10 more [me]
Fork picks: the Meteor Hammer line, Unstoppable Force, Lightning Collision [me]
gear: Galactic Impact (3 pts) is the first big damage spike [one]

stages.name: Endgame
stages.goal: Lead with the Warhammer for burst damage, and keep Axe & Shield for escapes and survival.
weapons: Thunder Dash Lunastone for Lightning ATK [one]
Axe & Shield as your emergency swap [ok]
skills: Full rotation in the section below [one]
Thundering Hurl throws your stored Thunder stacks (12 stacks in RaidDex's guide) [ok]
Reconstruction restores HP while you hold Power Surge Lv. 1 at low HP [one]
traits: Astron Plains has 22 Coilstones = +44, for 94. Both trees finish: Warhammer 28, Axe & Shield 45, and 20 points in the Axe stat cluster [me]
Lower line: Thunder (Tough Skin → Compression) with Reconstruction for healing [me]
check: Land Thundering Hurl in a boss fight

rotation.title: Endgame Warhammer rotation
rotation.intro: RaidDex's Thunderclap chain [one]. Holding block puts you in Power Surge, which cuts the damage you take and makes you stagger-immune while you charge [ok]. Each charge level pushes Meteor Hammer up a stage.

steps.d: Hold block to Lv. 1, then release. This turns on Meteor Hammer.
Meteor Hammer II raises it to Lv. 2.
Masterpiece raises it to Lv. 3. Commit only once the boss's swing is over or a teammate has it stunned.
Use both right after Devastating Blow.
Unstoppable Force refreshes Lv. 3 and gives you a shield. Skilled PvP players can sidestep Pulverize.
Consumes Meteor Hammer and builds Thunder. At 12 stacks, throw Thundering Hurl.

rotation.after: Don't sprint or swap mid-chain, because either one ends Meteor Hammer. Swap to Axe & Shield with {Q} only to escape or survive. You get five HP potions per fight [one].

disputes: AOEAH gives it 5/10 and ranks it last. A creator tier list puts it at D for PvE. ArcheAge Builds rates it C for solo play. RaidDex lists its Warhammer build at S tier (Nov 12).
Level with Axe & Shield and lead with the Warhammer at endgame, ideally in a group that stuns for you.
Wikily lists Meteor Hammer and Meteor Hammer II at 2 each. Your screen had 4 points pending on Meteor Hammer, Meteor Hammer II, Evasive Assault and Fire ATK.
Older guides say 92 or 100. RaidDex's Coilstone list: 47 × 2 = 94.
94. RaidDex's 49 / 51 split predates the Coilstone count.
RaidDex: STR, then CON and END tied. AAC Tools' demo values per point: END +6.6 SP and +4.2 defense, CON +7.2 HP.
STR first, Endurance second (charged swings and dodges drain SP), CON third, Talent 23 [me].

trees.intro: Matches your Warhammer screen: 9 granted skills on the left and Proficiency at the top. Costs follow the in-game markers: "3" nodes cost 3, all others 1, and granted skills (✓) are free. Where branches split and rejoin you take one side, and the other turns red [me]. On your screen, the 4 points pending were Meteor Hammer, Meteor Hammer II, Evasive Assault and Fire ATK. Forks: Fire (Surging Heat) or Meteor Hammer line, one of the three Pulverize lines, Planar Fracture or Lightning Collision, the Burn or Thunder lower line, and one leaf at the bottom. Full tree with choices made: 28–31 points.

nodes.e: Two-hit light combo. The first hit knocks back and the second knocks down.
Three-hit heavy combo: a leap with Guard Break, area damage with Slow, then area damage with Knockdown. Brief Stagger immunity.
Leap and slam down.
Ready stance that charges an attack up to Lv. 2. Reduces damage taken while held and grants Stagger immunity.
Blocking without charging Power Surge triggers a quick Stagger attack.
Follows a Lv. 1 Power Surge charge. Reduces damage taken and grants Stagger immunity. On hit, damages nearby enemies and knocks them down.
Follows a Lv. 2 Power Surge charge. Same defense as Tempered Blow, and hits harder.
Dodge in the chosen direction.
Strikes down after a dodge. The second hit knocks back.
Lets you equip warhammers.
Follows Shattering Blow, builds Burn, and grants brief Stagger immunity.
Surging Heat grants Forged (more Fire ATK). Shattering Blow adds a Burn hit while it's active.
After Surging Heat, a chain of explosions that grows with each blast.
At 5 Forged stacks, the next light attack fires Surging Heat with two extra Canned Heat blasts.
Tempered Blow grants Meteor Hammer (more Physical PEN and Exhaust). Lost when you sprint or swap weapons.
Tempered or Devastating Blow during Meteor Hammer raises it to Lv. 2.
After a dodge, follow up with Pulverize's second attack. Costs extra SP.
+20 Fire ATK.
Burn hits or Devastating Blow during Meteor Hammer Lv. 2 raise it to Lv. 3.
Pulverize's first attack refreshes Meteor Hammer Lv. 3.
Pulverize's second attack adds a Burn hit.
Pulverize's third attack leaves a fissure that erupts after a delay.
Pulverize's first attack grants a temporary shield.
Repeats Pulverize's second attack.
Pulverize's third attack costs no SP.
Fast, high-damage attack that can combo. Disables Tempered and Devastating Blow while active. Reduces damage taken and grants Stagger immunity.
Area damage that builds Burn.
Charges an enemy and builds Shock. Reduces damage taken and grants Stagger immunity.
Usable only during Meteor Hammer. Consumes it and adds hits based on its level.
While Forged, Crushing Slam consumes it for continuous area damage and Shock.
Inflicting Shock briefly raises Physical and Magic DEF.
Earth Shatter's second hit combos into Surging Heat.
Devastating Blow greatly raises Lightning ATK for a short time.
Low-damage combo skill that builds Burn.
Power Surge charges to Lv. 1 faster.
Surging Heat keeps Blue Flame and can repeat while it's active.
Crackling Flame adds a hit and grants Forged.
Instantly uses Pulverize's third attack on a downed target.
At low HP, holding Power Surge Lv. 1 restores HP every second.
After Pulverize's third attack, Devastating Blow can cost HP instead of SP.
Spends all Thunder stacks on a heavy hammer throw that builds Shock. Resonating Strike grants Thunder.

trees.intro: Matches your Axe screen: 10 granted skills on the left (Axe Smash and Barbaric Strike lead into Body Slam, Forceful Lunge, Tremor Strike and Stomp, plus Shield Up → Battle Cry and Evade → Uppercut), Proficiency with Death Ward under it, a 17-node Battle Cry/Shield branch, an 18-node Reckless Destroyer branch, and the stat cluster on the right. Costs follow the in-game markers: the 8 "3" nodes cost 3, all others 1, and the ✓ skills are free. Forks: Rally or Brutality, Tempest or Perseverance, Shield Slam - Stun or Shield Crash, Dominance or Fervent Step, Steadfast or Rousing Call. Full tree with choices made: 45 points. The stat cluster keeps Wikily's 10 and 5 point costs, which aren't confirmed in-game [me].

treeHelp: Click a node to read it. Double-click it, or press Space, to unlock or refund it. ✓ = granted free. Red = locked because you took the other side of that fork. Fill with my points follows the leveling plan across both weapons until your points run out. Saved in this browser.
budgetIntro: Early Access has 47 Raeven's Coilstones at 2 trait points each, 94 in total [one]. Region counts are RaidDex's [one] and level bands are archeagechroniclesdata's [one]. You only reach these totals if you take every Coilstone as you go. Both weapons spend from the same pool.

weaponGuide.intro: Every Berserker starts with Axe & Shield, the class's default weapon [ok]. Start your trait points there. It keeps you alive while you level, and the Warhammer's core combo (Pulverize, Power Surge, Tempered and Devastating Blow) is already free.

pros: Sustain: Battle Cry heals and staggers bosses, Shield Up blocks, and Death Ward gives 15 s of immortality [ok]
Rated highest of the Berserker weapons: AOEAH 10/10 PvE, 9/10 PvP [ok]
Reel In and Brutal Crash pull and pin targets [one]
cons: Weak against highly evasive PvP targets [one]
items.skip: Leveling on the Warhammer alone means slow, missable charged swings with long recovery and no heal. Guides call that tricky solo and in boss fights [ok].

pros: The biggest burst: Galactic Impact, Lightning Collision, Thundering Hurl [ok]
Damage reduction and stagger immunity while charging Power Surge [ok]
The core combo is free, so the 28 points all add power [me]
cons: Slowest weapon. A missed charge leaves you exposed [ok]
Rated 5/10 by AOEAH, with mixed tier lists [ok]
Meteor Hammer ends if you sprint or swap weapons [ok]
items.skip: You give up the class's burst finisher. Fine for leveling, but bosses take longer.

plans.name: Axe first, Warhammer second (recommended)
plans.note: 93 of 94 points. Steps 1–16 are Diamond Shores (all Axe). The Warhammer starts in Gylden Ruins. The last 20 points go into the Axe stat cluster at Wikily's listed cost [me].

plans.name: Warhammer first (as on your screen)
plans.note: For when you've already put points into the Warhammer, as on your screen (10 points). The Warhammer's first 22 points take it through Reconstruction, then Axe sustain comes in Gylden Ruins. Same 93-point end state as the recommended plan [me].
